CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation relation to a specific content's organization/presentation/access is present.

COD.rationale: Content (red positions), an organizational description (grid/positions), and a separate origin/status entry are all explicitly present and bound to the same referent/time.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation or content-processing condition is tied to the same content's organization/access in the text.

C.rationale: The report explicitly lists identified contents (color-labeled cell sets) with coordinates.

D.rationale: Origins/metadata entries separately label the status/source of the recorded contents, distinguishing identity from provenance/access status.

O.rationale: The text states how contents are organized/presented (grid orientation and explicit coordinate groupings).
